# John Costa — jcosta.tech

> Personal site of John Costa, a software engineer and AI-augmented builder in Oakland, CA. Writing on AI-assisted engineering, open source, and building in public. 125 merged pull requests across 38+ open source repositories in 6 languages, tracked live at /contributions.html.

Every blog post is also available as raw markdown: append index.md to the post URL.
